nestedHookFinding.title: [P2] Wire hooks for the enclosing repository and app directory
nestedHookFinding.explanation: The prepare command runs Husky inside app/, where no .git exists; installation reports '.git can't be found' and core.hooksPath is unset. Additionally, .husky/pre-commit changes to the enclosing root, where its pinned lint-staged command cannot resolve. Configure installation from the Git root targeting app/.husky and execute checks from app/. Removing the read-only restriction alone would not fix these paths.
